title: When the Orbit Wakes Again
author: Wren Vane
blurb: Oscar Marchetti, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
